description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from WIKIPEDIA-CMMI, Wikipedia revision 1367486293 (wikitext sha256 d32c94f84164f10476dfa383a649aa1d5f83cf55b5ca5cd79c0a8e15ba04cad6): table Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI) core process areas (model framework v1.3; CMMI v2.0 and later renamed process areas to practice areas), by abbreviation. CAR: Causal Analysis and Resolution (Support, maturity level 5). CM: Configuration Management (Support, maturity level 2). DAR: Decision Analysis and Resolution (Support, maturity level 3). IPM: Integrated Project Management (Project management, maturity level 3). MA: Measurement and Analysis (Support, maturity level 2). OPD: Organizational Process Definition (Process management, maturity level 3). OPF: Organizational Process Focus (Process management, maturity level 3). OPM: Organizational Performance Management (Process management, maturity level 5). OPP: Organizational Process Performance (Process management, maturity level 4). OT: Organizational Training (Process management, maturity level 3). PMC: Project Monitoring and Control (Project management, maturity level 2). PP: Project Planning (Project management, maturity level 2). PPQA: Process and Product Quality Assurance (Support, maturity level 2). QPM: Quantitative Project Management (Project management, maturity level 4). REQM: Requirements Management (Project management, maturity level 2). RSKM: Risk Management (Project management, maturity level 3). SAM: Supplier Agreement Management (Support, maturity level 2).
title: CMMI core process area
